Be sure to subscribe and watch all of our featured videos!

Physical Therapy 101 was created by board certified Physical Therapists Anderson Dart and Nicholas Gallo.  This channel features expert instruction for a wide variety of Physical Therapy related topics.  Topics include: exercise instruction, brace fitting, and assistive device fitting/usage.  The goal of this channel is to ensure that patients use devices and perform exercises correctly to avoid injury.

https://www.physicaltherapy101.net
